title: Dutch Care Worker with Bundibugyo Ebola Admitted to Leiden Isolation Unit
detail: A care worker in the DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo virus on 29 September and was repatriated to the Netherlands, where they were admitted on 1 October to the high-level isolation unit at Leiden University Medical Center, according to RIVM.

media.caption: RIVM update on repatriated Ebola patient
